items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: we used to go around and listen to Tony Jackson... Tony Jackson played a marvelous piano

ctx.x: The Oriental Foxtrot Orchestra. And they do all those numbers like Dardanella and as well as a lot of the local numbers. They do Purple, Rosa, Cairo sometimes.
Well maybe Lee Kelly come into the Court of Two Sisters when Tony and I was working in the courtyard place, I don't know what they... What was it called?
Huh? That room we were in. Jimmy Cooper built that little place in the back. You're talking about the place on Bourbon? Yeah.

items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: I gave him to Kurt to hold... Well, he used to play Black Keys... And he claims he wrote the voice... See, his daughter is married to Mr. Weaver.

ctx.x: I gave him to Kurt to hold, because I was afraid I might spill beer on him.
Stale Bread played piano, did he? Who?

Well, he used to play Black Keys, you know. Black Keys. Okay, alright. And he claims he wrote the voice, he's a creator of jazz. That out, I got a paper about it, and on his grave he's got something about that. See, his daughter is married to Mr. Weaver. And I was out to the side, Tony came out, or Cindy rather, and went to the grave and put some flowers on it.
